geometry: Continuous close-fitting tube and conductor passages through the shared upper bend and tip
user_quotes: We need the "tight conformance" carried through everywhere we can.
It just needs to have a hole, and not such a large one, so that if we get water up there we get the drip.
purpose: Carry the base passage conformance through the tip, without transverse guide discs or a large round drain cavity; retain a visible unsealed fault drip.
continuous_centre_opening: Tube-centre triangle/quadrilateral follows the actual paths to remove isolated webs between bores; its smooth loft uses at most 2 mm arc-station pitch.
preservation_method: Added close-fitting stock and common-centre cuts start at upper tip station zero; the base ends before station zero. Outer neck, female socket, display retention and dispense-face constructions are unchanged. Existing nominal tubing paths are unchanged.
scope: Nominal geometry and sampled clearances. Native slice review is separate. Actual tube threading, cleanup, drip behavior, retention strength and lifetime require physical observation.
